title: The Drop
logline: The night before their first big tournament, a cold box lands at an esports team house. The captain opens it on camera, the squad gets its first taste of {product}, and three scrims later nobody is tired.

world.setting: The shared team house of the fictional esports team Kestrel Six, a rented suburban house turned gaming house: a living room with a sagging grey couch, a coffee table, and three gaming stations along the wall, 10pm the night before the fictional Coldharbor Invitational, then 1am during practice scrims.
world.palette: Magenta and cyan RGB strips against warm overhead light; neutral packaging (kraft cardboard, silver insulated liner, white foam) so the silver and sky-blue can is the only hero colour when it comes out.
fictional_brands: Kestrel Six (esports team, plain sky-blue jerseys, a simple bird silhouette on the chest, no lettering)
Coldharbor Invitational (tournament, never shown as text)
world.rules: The box is plain kraft with one plain sky-blue sticker, no courier labels or text. Monitors show only abstract blurred colour, no game UI. Keyboards, headsets and chairs have no logos. Each person holds exactly one can. All cast are adults (21 to 23).

ingested.moment: cans lifted from the cold box, cracked together and sipped for first reactions

applied.moment: tubes or jars lifted from the box and tried on the back of a hand or face in front of the group (skincare, balm, hair product)

worn.moment: each teammate pulls theirs from the box and puts it on right there (jersey, hoodie, glasses, headset, sneakers)

handheld.moment: the device is lifted out of its foam slot, switched on and passed around (controller, mouse, earbuds, gadget)

carried.moment: the bag comes out of the box and gets unzipped and packed on the coffee table (backpack, gear case, sleeve)

home.moment: the item is unpacked and set up at the stations or in the room (chair, lamp, desk mat, speaker)

consumable.moment: packs come out of the box and each teammate opens one and tries it (snack, gum, hydration mix)

beats.summary: A frosty box hauled through the front door at night toward the lens; the captain names the stakes: tournament tomorrow, and it just landed.
The box hits the coffee table, the skeptic asks why it's cold, top-down tape rip and a puff of cold air.
POV from inside the box up at three faces; the captain lifts one can to the lens and names it.
Three cans crack together, then fast first-sip reactions, one face per shot.
1am practice: the squad still sharp, Owen jumps up after a third straight win.
Kiara at her station holds her can to the lens: get yours before game day, and the tagline.
